verdict.rationale: Ramp's reimbursements page says employees can be reimbursed in more than 70 countries and 40 currencies, paid in two days or less in their local currency. Because this sits inside Ramp's own reimbursement workflow, no separate international payments process is needed. Ramp also natively documents reimbursement handling, including submit, approve and sync to accounting. Missing for 10: any in-depth first-party docs on how international reimbursement payouts work (FX rates, fees, supported country list, employee bank-detail collection), and independent or hands-on corroboration; the claim rests on a single marketing statement.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can reimburse employees abroad in their local currency without running a separate international payments process

citations.quote: Reimburse employees with confidence in more than 70 countries and 40 currencies, knowing they can be paid in two days or less in their local currency.
